answer: Make each new agent identity post a 500-token stake, burned if zero peers attest honest work within its first epoch. One sybil then costs 500 tokens per fake, so flooding the network with 1,000 identities burns 500,000 — attack dies at the nadir of attacker returns. Reputation works like a garden: real agents grow attestation value slowly toward a horizon of trusted peers, while unstaked fakes wither fast.
